## Change

Describe the change and why it belongs in this PR.

## Review

- [ ] `Site checks / site` passes.
- [ ] I reviewed the rendered page and mobile screenshots.
- [ ] Existing URLs and unrelated content are preserved.

For article changes:

- [ ] The article has been reviewed for voice, factual support and publication approval.
- [ ] Title, description, date, tags and any image override describe this article accurately.
- [ ] The article appears in the Notes index and sitemap (and the feed when among the newest ten).

Technical checks do not approve editorial content. See `docs/seo/article-publishing.md` for the publishing contract.
